steps.prompt: Before the check: which part of this unit feels easiest, and which do you want to look at again?

cards.title: Verbs: quick review
cards.body: Action verbs show doing (sprinted, wonders). Linking verbs connect to a description (is, was, seems, became, tastes). Helping verbs come before the main verb (will, can, has, was, did). Choose strong, precise action verbs.

cards.title: Tenses: quick review
cards.body: Simple: walked · walk(s) · will walk. Progressive (be + -ing): was walking · is walking · will be walking. Perfect (have + participle): had walked · has walked · will have walked. Irregular verbs: went/gone, saw/seen, brought, caught, wrote/written. Never “I seen”, “have went” or “should of”. Keep one tense unless the time changes.

cards.title: Agreement: quick review
cards.body: One subject → singular verb (she runs, it is, he has, he doesn’t). More than one → plural verb (they run, we are, they have, they don’t). Cover the words between subject and verb. Everyone/each/nobody are singular; two subjects with “and” are plural.

cards.title: How the check works
cards.body: First, a 10-question quiz: you need 8 right (80%) to pass. If you don’t pass, you’ll see which skills to review, and you’ll get new questions next time. Then you’ll write a short paragraph that shows off everything you’ve learned. Quill gives it a score.

prompts: What did you learn about verbs or tenses that you didn’t know before this unit?
Which verb skill will you check for when you write your next essay?
